sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 objected the submissions made by the revisionist and submitted that cross-examination of the witness P.W.-1 has not commenced and at this stage re-examination of the witness on the point of motive is not permissible.
6. On the basis of above discussions there appears no illegality, material irregularity or manifest error in the impugned order.
This criminal revision is disposed of with the direction that after cross-examination of P.W.-1 (witness) who is victim of the case, shall be re-examined on the point of motive only.
7. Accordingly, this Criminal Revision is disposed of.
